name: Chubb Singapore

products.name: Chubb PAL Protect II
products.subtype: adult / couple plan with dependent child cover
products.summary: Personal accident plan (Chubb Personal Accident & Lifestyle Protect II) covering accident-related injuries and disabilities, plus up to 14 types of covered diseases.
facts: Accidental Death: up to S$1,000,000 lump sum, doubled if the accident happens on a public conveyance
Accidental Permanent Disability: up to S$1,000,000 lump sum
Daily Income Relief: up to S$300 daily if hospitalised due to accidental injury
Covers 14 infectious diseases including Dengue Fever, Hand, Foot & Mouth Disease (HFMD), food poisoning
Free automatic dependent child(ren) cover for Couple Plan (up to 4 children)
products.evidence: With Chubb PAL Protect ® II (Chubb Personal Accident & Lifestyle Protect ® II)

products.name: Hospital Income Insurance
products.summary: Daily hospital cash benefits for hospitalisation due to accidents or illnesses, distributed through partners and intermediaries.
facts: Daily hospital cash benefit due to accidents or illnesses
products.evidence: Chubb offers hospital income insurance, through our partners and intermediaries

products.name: Dental Insurance
products.summary: Dental cover for emergency treatments and routine visits, distributed through partners and intermediaries.
facts: Coverage on emergency dental treatments, routine preventive treatments and X-rays
Coverage on teeth extractions and root canal treatments
Access to a wide network of dental clinics
products.evidence: Chubb offers dental insurance, through our partners and intermediaries

notes: Individuals & Families menu lists Travel, Home, Accident, Personal (dental, hospital income, jewellery, mobile phone) and Pets only; skipped travel, home, pet, jewellery, mobile phone as out of scope.
No product PDFs (brochure, product summary, policy wording) are linked from the three product pages, so pdfs is empty for all.
Hospital Income and Dental pages name no product brand and give no limits; both say they are distributed through partners and intermediaries.
Life, health and CI plans may be sold by a separate Chubb life entity; none appear on chubb.com/sg-en, and chubblife.com.sg refused a scripted request, so nothing was confirmed there.
